manifest.provenance: protected_area features are REAL: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) / World Database on OECMs (WDOECM), UNEP-WCMC and IUCN, Egypt extract dated July 2026 (47 sites), plus one clearly-labeled SYNTHETIC teaching scenario (id=demo-protected-scenario) used only to demonstrate the critical-finding path in the demo UI. industrial_zone, substation, and road features remain hand-drawn SYNTHETIC approximations (no free authoritative Egyptian source was available for these layers). industrial_zone (10th of Ramadan), road, and substation features were upgraded to real OpenStreetMap data via the Overpass API on 2026-07-28 (40 industrial sectors unioned, nearest named road, nearest 2 substations). The 6th of October industrial zone remains a synthetic placeholder (out of scope for this data-refresh pass).
manifest.coverage: protected_area: real, national (all WDPA-listed Egyptian sites as of the July 2026 extract), plus one synthetic demo polygon. industrial_zone/substation/road: two named zones only, synthetic.
limitations: 6th of October industrial_zone is still a hand-drawn synthetic placeholder.
OSM industrial/road/substation data is community-mapped (ODbL license), not an official IDA/utility cadastral or grid dataset; coverage may be incomplete.
protected_area WDPA features are real but the dataset snapshot may lag new designations; always confirm with EEAA for a specific site.
The synthetic demo protected-area polygon does not represent a real boundary and exists only to exercise the critical-finding code path in demos.
